{{pkmn|Puzzle Challenge}}, {{pkmn|Stadium 2}}, {{pkmn|Masters EX}} |leader=no |elite=yes |specialist=yes |type={{t|Psychic}} types |team=no |brain=no |anime=no |gameanim=yes |envagame=Philip Reich[https://www.facebook.com/phillreich/posts/1889239661179364?__tn__=-R Phillip Reich on Facebook] ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |javagame=[[Hirofumi Nojima]]Nintendo DREAM (vol. 329) ({{pkmn|Masters EX}}) |pv=yes |pvnum=GOTCHA! |pvname=GOTCHA! }} '''Will''' (Japanese: '''イツキ''' ''Itsuki'') is a {{type|Psychic}} {{pkmn|Trainer}} and member of the [[Indigo Plateau|Indigo]] [[Elite Four]]. ==In the core series games== Will is the first member of the [[Indigo League]] [[Elite Four]] in the [[Generation II]] and [[Generation IV]] games, filling in the spot previously filled by [[Lorelei]]. He achieved his Elite Four position fairly recently as a result of {{pkmn|training}} around the {{pkmn|world}} with his {{type|Psychic}} Pokémon and he has a strong ambition to become the strongest trainer in the world. ===Appearance=== Will is a tall, slender man with straight, shoulder-length purple hair that curves inward at the ends, parted to the side and covering his right eye. He wears a black domino mask that conceals the area around his eyes. His visible eye is dark and narrow. In [[Generation II]], Will wears a formal, dark brown blazer with a subtle textured pattern and red cuffs, paired with a light blue collared shirt and a red tie. His trousers are magenta, slightly flared at the bottom, and he wears black shoes. His left hand is gloved in white, while his right hand remains uncovered. In {{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}}, Will's outfit becomes more elaborate. He wears a black patterned sleeveless tailcoat with gold trim and four large yellow buttons arranged in two rows. The coat is open at the front, revealing a purple undershirt and a wide yellow waistband. Underneath the tailcoat, he wears a white cravat. His magenta pants remain the same in color, and he wears black shoes. His hairstyle and mask remain consistent with his earlier appearance. ===Pokémon=== This listing is for Will's Pokémon in the video games in which he has appeared. {{color2|000|Pokémon Stadium 2|Stadium 2}} |} ==Quotes== {{main|Will/Quotes}} ==In animation== ===GOTCHA!=== Will briefly appeared in [[GOTCHA!]]. ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== [[File:Johto Elite Four Adventures.png|thumb|230px|Will in Pokémon Adventures]] ====History==== =====Past===== Will, along with [[Karen]], {{adv|Green}}, {{adv|Silver}}, [[Sham]], and [[Carl]], was one of the children raised by the [[Masked Man]] to be his servants. Unlike Silver and Green, Will was not kidnapped and went to the Masked Man willingly out of boredom. ====={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}===== Will debuted with Karen at the [[Ilex Forest]], where they have been tasked with guarding the area. When Green arrived to stop the Masked Man's plan to capture {{p|Celebi}}, she was attacked by Will and Karen. With the {{adv|Tower duo|Lugia and Ho-Oh}} they borrowed from the Masked Man, Will and Karen exploited Green's fear of birds to torture her. When Green learned that Will and Karen also defeated and captured Silver, she overcame her fear of birds and sent out {{p|Articuno}}, {{p|Zapdos}}, and {{p|Moltres}} to fight. Green and her allies, {{adv|Red}} and {{adv|Blue}}, each used one of the legendary birds to battle Will and Karen. With the assistance of many Pokémon sent from all across [[Johto]] and [[Kanto]], Lugia and Ho-Oh were freed from the Masked Man's control and flew away. Defeated, Will made his escape, only to be punished later by the Masked Man for doing so. After the Masked Man's defeat, Will and Karen were approached by [[Bruno]] and [[Koga]], who offered to form an alliance since all four of them were once members of various criminal organizations. ====={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}===== It is revealed that Will, Karen, Bruno, and Koga were all made members of the Johto [[Elite Four]] by the [[Pokémon Association]]. The Johto Elite Four went to the [[Pokéathlon]] as an act of promotion for the Pokémon League. There, they met {{adv|Gold}}, whom they challenged to the Power Course. Although they easily defeated Gold in the first two events, Gold gained enough points in the third event to win overall. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Will's Pokémon in the Pokémon Adventures manga. =====On hand===== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Will |pkmn=Xatu |stage1=Natu |type1=Psychic |type2=Flying |img=Will Natu Psychic Adventures.png |cap=Will's Natu |img2=Will Xatu Adventures.png |epnum=PS173 |epname=The Last Battle VII |desc={{p|Xatu}} is Will's first known Pokémon. It was first used to attack Green at the Ilex Forest. Green's fear of birds prevented her from fighting back. Later, it was used against {{adv|Silver}} while on Lugia's back. After being weakened by a {{m|Beat Up}} from Silver's entire team, Xatu was defeated by a {{m|Return}} from [[Silver's Feraligatr]]. In ''[[PS268|The Escape]]'', it was revealed to have evolved from a {{p|Natu}}. Xatu's only known move is {{m|Psychic}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Will |pkmn=Exeggutor |type1=Grass |type2=Psychic |img=Will Exeggutor Adventures.png |img_size=120px |epnum=PS443 |epname=Attaway, Aipom! |desc={{p|Exeggutor}} first appeared alongside its Trainer at the [[Pokéathlon]]. It was used to challenge Gold in the Goal Roll event, where it easily won. None of Exeggutor's moves are known.}} =====Borrowed===== {{TrainerPoké |main=Tower duo (Adventures) |trainer=Masked Man |pkmn=Lugia |type1=Psychic |type2=Flying |img=Masked Man Lugia.png |epnum=PS088 |epname=The Beedrill All and End All |desc=The Masked Man lent {{p|Lugia}} to Will in order to guard the [[Ilex Forest]]. Will used Lugia to battle {{adv|Green}}, {{adv|Red}}, and {{adv|Blue}}, who used {{p|Articuno}}, {{p|Zapdos}}, and {{p|Moltres}}, respectively. During the battle, many Pokémon sent from people from Kanto and Johto came to assist. The Pokémon latched on to Lugia and {{p|Ho-Oh}}, and their combined power freed the two from the Masked Man's control. Now freed, Lugia and Ho-Oh flew off to parts unknown.}} ====Pokémon competitions==== Will has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Pokéathlon]] - Goal Roll; Winner (''[[PS443|Attaway, Aipom!]]'') ===Pokémon Pocket Monsters=== [[File:Will PM.png|100px|thumb|Will in Pokémon Pocket Monsters]] Will appeared in ''[[PM106|A Challenge to the Elite Four]]''. He, along with [[Bruno]] and [[Koga]], fell from the [[Indigo Plateau|Elite Four Tower]], seemingly defeated by [[Karen]]. Red asked them what happened, but Koga asked him to ask Karen herself. It is later revealed that after being exhausted from training, Karen decided to tell them a joke, and they fell down the building after hearing her dumb joke. ====Pokémon==== {{anchor|Exeggutor 2}}{{TrainerPoké |width=79 |trainer=Will |pkmn=Exeggutor |type1=Grass |type2=Psychic |img=Will Exeggutor PM.png |epnum=PM106 |epname=A Challenge to the Elite Four! |desc={{p|Exeggutor}} is Will's only known Pokémon. This is rectified in {{game|HeartGold and SoulSilver|s}}, where his overworld sprite clearly shows two eyes, both obscured by white. * Will has several similarities with [[Lorelei]]: both of them are the first challenger of Kanto [[Elite Four]]; both of them have used {{p|Slowbro}} and {{p|Jynx}} in their respective parties; they have similar hairstyles; and both of them have had their hair depicted as either purple or red. * There is data in {{game|Crystal}} for the gender of every Trainer class in the game, with the exception of [[Eusine]]. This is used to select which dialogue pool to sample from when randomly choosing the opponent's dialogue. Will is one of two male characters to be identified as female in this array, the other being [[Bugsy]]. * All of Will's Pokémon (excluding Jynx, which is a female-only species) changed from male in {{3v2|Gold|Silver|Crystal}} to female in HeartGold and SoulSilver. ** Similarly to [[Saturn]], Bugsy, and [[Janine]], Will's Pokémon are the opposite gender despite them having a 50-50 gender ratio. * Will is the only member of the [[Indigo Plateau]] [[Elite Four]] (in Generation II and HeartGold and SoulSilver) that uses only Pokémon of the type that he specializes in the first match. All others have at least one Pokémon not of their specialty in their first match, and, with the exception of [[Lance]], replace the Pokémon not of their specialty with Pokémon of their specialty in rematches. ** He shares this trait with [[Lucian]] of the [[Sinnoh]] Elite Four in {{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}}. Coincidentally, both use Psychic-type Pokémon. *Although Elite Four members usually aren't known to have titles or slogans like Gym Leaders do, a {{DL|Mission (TCG Pocket)|Themed Collection}} in [[Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket]] refers to Will as "The Man in the Mysterious Mask."
